title: Soroban execution and storage model
selectWhen: Always. Establish Soroban-specific authorization, rollback, storage, TTL, cross-contract, token, time, and resource semantics.

title: Numeric conversions, precision, and rounding
selectWhen: The repository performs casts, fixed-point math, decimal scaling, fee calculations, share conversions, ratios, prices, interest, or signed arithmetic.

title: DeFi accounting and economic manipulation
selectWhen: The repository manages deposits, shares, reserves, donations, liquidity, fees, debt, collateral, rewards, swaps, vaults, auctions, or liquidations.

title: State transitions and representation consistency
selectWhen: Security depends on lifecycle states, repeated operations, cached and persisted objects, auctions, claims, queued actions, role aliasing, replay protection, or multi-step procedures.

title: Cross-contract and token interaction safety
selectWhen: Public paths invoke user-selected or configurable contracts, token clients, callbacks, routers, pools, bridges, or other external dependencies.
